notes.title: 2025/03/08 Added volume settings
notes.content:
Added volume settings, you can set the volume of BGM, you can set the volume of sound effects
增加音量设置，可以设置BGM的音量大小，可以设置音效的音量大小

Fixed the page turning stuck bug when viewing more than 100 network ranking items
